## Objective
Create the playable page: `index.html` with a canvas board, score and best-score display and a start/game-over overlay; `style.css`; `src/main.js`, which drives the game from keyboard input on a timer using the logic module `src/game.js` (global `SnakeGame`); and a short `README.md`. The page must work by double-clicking `index.html` (file://), so everything is classic scripts with no ES modules and no build step.

## Interface
Read `src/game.js` first. It is a contract stub today and is implemented by another task running in parallel; rely only on its documented API, exposed as the global `SnakeGame` once `<script src="src/game.js">` has loaded:
- `SnakeGame.createGame(config?, rng?)` returns a `GameState`: `{ width, height, snake: {x,y}[] (head first), direction, queue, food: {x,y} | null, score, status: 'playing' | 'over' | 'won' }`
- `SnakeGame.turn(state, 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right')` returns a new state (the same object when the turn is rejected)
- `SnakeGame.step(state)` returns a new state
- `SnakeGame.tickDelayMs(score)` returns milliseconds until the next tick
States are never mutated, so always store the returned value.

Files to create:
- `index.html`: `<!doctype html>`, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">`, a header showing `Score: <span id="score">` and `Best: <span id="best">`, a wrapper (position: relative) containing `<canvas id="board">` and a `<div id="overlay">` that contains `<p id="message">`. At the end of `<body>`, in this order, `<script src="src/game.js"></script>` then `<script src="src/main.js"></script>`. Ids must use double-quoted attributes.
- `style.css`: dark page, board centred with a border, overlay absolutely positioned over the canvas with a translucent dark background and centred text, `#overlay[hidden] { display: none; }`.
- `src/main.js`: one IIFE, classic script. Every element lookup must be written exactly as `document.getElementById("board")` (double quotes, literal id) for the ids `board`, `score`, `best`, `overlay`, `message`; an integration check greps for these.
- `README.md`: what the game is, controls, how to run (open `index.html`, or `python3 -m http.server` and browse to it), and how to run the tests (`node --test test/game.test.js`).

## Behavior
1. Start: on load create a game with `SnakeGame.createGame()` and render it. UI phase is `ready`; the overlay is visible (not `hidden`) with message `Press an arrow key or Space to start`. Score shows 0; best shows the stored best score.
2. Canvas: cell size 24 px; set `canvas.width = state.width * 24` and `canvas.height = state.height * 24`. Draw a dark background, the food as a red filled circle or square, the snake body in green and the head in a lighter green. The board is redrawn after every tick, restart and accepted key press.
3. Keys: `ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right` and `w/a/s/d` (case-insensitive) map to `up/down/left/right`. In phase `running`, call `SnakeGame.turn` and store the result. In phase `ready`, the first such key also starts the game after applying the turn. Keys while `paused` or `finished` are ignored. Call `event.preventDefault()` for arrow keys and Space so the page does not scroll.
4. Space: `ready` starts the game; `running` pauses it (overlay shows `Paused - press Space to resume`); `paused` resumes it; `finished` restarts with a fresh `SnakeGame.createGame()` and starts running immediately.
5. Loop: while `running`, a single `setTimeout` chain calls `SnakeGame.step(state)`, redraws, updates the score text, then schedules the next tick after `SnakeGame.tickDelayMs(state.score)` ms. The overlay is hidden while running.
6. Finish: when the stepped state's `status` is `'over'` or `'won'`, stop scheduling ticks, set phase `finished`, show the overlay with `Game over - score N. Press Space to play again` (or `You win! Score N. Press Space to play again` for `'won'`).
7. Best score: after finishing, if `state.score` exceeds the stored best, update the `best` text and save it. Storage key `snake.best` in `localStorage`; every storage access is wrapped in try/catch and a missing, unparsable or unavailable value counts as 0.
8. Single loop: pausing, finishing and restarting call `clearTimeout` on the pending timer, so no more than one tick chain ever exists.
9. Hidden tab: when `document.visibilityState` becomes `'hidden'` while `running`, behave as if Space had paused the game.

## Invariants
- `src/main.js` must not modify or re-implement game rules (movement, collisions, food, speed); it only calls `SnakeGame`.
- No `import`/`export`, no external URLs, fonts, libraries or network access. Plain ES2018+ JavaScript, two-space indentation, double quotes in `src/main.js` (so the id lookups match the integration check).
- `index.html` loads `src/game.js` before `src/main.js`.

## Edge cases
- `localStorage` may throw (private mode, file:// restrictions): the game must still run, with best staying in memory for the session.
- A key press repeated by key auto-repeat must not cause errors or extra timers.
- `state.food` can be `null` only when the status is `'won'`; the draw function must not assume food exists.

## Guardrails
- Create only the four files listed; do not edit `src/game.js` (stub today, owned by T2) or any file under `test/`.
- Do not add tests, package.json, bundlers or a service worker.
- Do not guess the logic API beyond what is documented in `src/game.js`; in particular do not read `state` fields that are not listed in the Interface section.
- Exact element ids (`board`, `score`, `best`, `overlay`, `message`) and the `document.getElementById` call with a literal double-quoted id are mandatory because `integration_verify` depends on them.

## Out of scope
Touch or swipe controls, sound, difficulty menus, themes, board-size selection, animations, mobile layout polish, and any game-rule changes.
